title: TD Epic Descriptor Schema
description: Schema for validating Anigma epic descriptors in Docs/td/. Each epic must have a corresponding epic.yaml file that conforms to this schema.

id.description: Unique epic identifier. Must match the directory name.

priority.description: Overall priority level for this epic.

status.description: Current status. Must match the directory location under Docs/td/.

lane.description: Functional grouping lane for this epic.

description.description: Detailed description of the epic's purpose and scope.

recommended_worktree.description: Default worktree path for all tasks in this epic.

source_docs.description: List of paths to source documentation that define this epic.

related_docs.description: List of paths to related documentation (roadmaps, ADRs, architecture docs).

proofs.description: List of paths to proof artifacts under Docs/proofs/ for the epic itself.

diagrams.description: List of paths to epic-specific diagrams.

tasks.description: List of task IDs that belong to this epic.

children.description: List of child task IDs (alias for tasks).

acceptance.description: Epic-level acceptance criteria that apply to all child tasks.

td_labels.description: Additional labels to apply to all tasks in this epic when creating TD entries.

blocks.description: List of task/epic IDs that this epic blocks.

depends_on.description: List of task/epic IDs that must be completed before this epic can start.

created.description: Date when this epic was initially created.

updated.description: Date when this epic was last updated.

completion_date.description: Date when this epic was marked complete.

verification_profiles.description: List of verification profile IDs from verification-profiles.yaml that apply to all tasks in this epic by default.

verification_overrides.description: Override verification profile settings for this specific epic.

gc_policy.description: Garbage collection policy for epic context: retain_all (keep all artifacts), compact_on_complete (remove worktrees on complete), compact_on_done (remove worktrees on done), archive_only (archive but don't delete). Default is retain_all for epics to preserve context for child tasks.

context_load_policy.description: Context loading policy: eager (load all context upfront), lazy (load as needed), on_demand (load only when explicitly requested), minimal (load only descriptor, not full context). Default is eager for epics.

research_stage.description: Current research stage for this epic. See TD_RESEARCH_AND_TIMELINE_DOCTRINE.md for stage semantics.

research_files.description: List of files inspected as part of epic-level research.

inspected_symbols.description: List of symbols inspected at the epic level. Only populated when actually inspected.

change_map.description: Path to the epic-level change-map.yaml file, if it exists.

timeline.description: Path to the epic-level timeline directory or file.

decisions.description: List of decision IDs from the epic's decision log.

path.description: Path to the affected documentation file.

canonical_doc_effects.description: Effects this epic has or will have on canonical documentation.

rule.description: The doctrine rule being aligned with.

reference.description: Path to the doctrine document containing this rule.

waiver_requested.description: Whether a waiver has been requested.

waiver_approved.description: Who approved the waiver, if granted.

doctrine_alignment.description: Epic-level doctrine alignment for planned changes.

affected_files.description: Files expected to be affected by this epic. Only populated when actually identified.

expected_proof.description: Proof artifacts expected to be generated by this epic.
